subject: social_studies
concept: Understanding that different types of government exist around the world (e.g. led by one person, led by elected representatives, led by a group of elders)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described government type to a simple picture representing how decisions get made in it
exercise.abstract: Student names one way a described government type makes its decisions

misconception_flags: assumes every country's government works exactly the same way

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
